notes_for_editor: Only the directory listing and a TopoQuest feature with coordinates. The directory gives the name Walnut Hill and Escambia County only; the TopoQuest name Walnut Hill Lookout Tower is not shown to be the same site. No build date, height, operator, staffing or status found. Towerdex pages returned HTTP 403 and were not used. The 2015 FFLA Florida report in the cache does not mention Walnut Hill.
